optional_capture.note: A future Swapchain2 capture path needs a new nonoverlapping allocation and latency proof; none is implied by this budget.

notes: All addresses are BT-private DDR byte offsets and intervals are half-open [start,end).
Atlas/scratch/staging/list sizes are declared engineering allowances, not measured STRUTHIO requirements.
4096-byte address alignment is a planning policy, not a verified complete BT alignment contract.
Native 16KiB RAM_DL and 16KiB RAM_CMD are separate BT regions and are not charged again here.
No register writes, hardware allocation, external shared RAM or cross-device DMA are performed.
